_readme: One entry per open position. To add a role, copy an entry and edit; set status to closed to hide it without deleting. placeholder: true marks roles that still need confirmation from the lab before publishing -- the page shows them with a 待确认 / TBC mark. Applications go to site.email unless apply_url is set.

location.zh: 北京 · 海淀（北京大学西门）
location.en: Beijing · Haidian (west gate of Peking University)

zh.title: AI 研究实习生 · Post-Training 与自我进化
zh.summary: 面向在读硕博（优秀本科生亦可），参与 LLM / Agent 的后训练与自我进化研究。表现优秀者有机会以第一作者或核心贡献者身份产出顶会成果。日薪 1000–5000 元，特别优秀者面议。
responsibilities: RL Post-Training：面向推理与 Agent 任务的强化学习方法，包括 GRPO、RLHF 等
Reward / Verifier Modeling：奖励模型、可验证奖励与自我纠错机制
Agentic Post-Training：Agent 的技能、记忆与工具调用架构
Self-Evolving Harness：可持续优化的训练与评测系统
requirements: 重点高校计算机、AI、数学、物理等相关专业在读硕博，优秀本科生亦可
有强化学习、大模型或 Agent 相关的研究或项目经历
具备科研热情、自驱力与独立解决问题的能力
每周到岗不少于 4 天，连续实习不少于 3 个月
加分项：顶会论文、高质量开源项目，或熟悉 verl / Megatron / DeepSpeed

en.title: Research Intern · Post-training and self-evolution
en.summary: For master's and doctoral students, and strong undergraduates: post-training and self-evolution research on LLMs and agents. Interns who do well have the chance to publish as first author or core contributor. CNY 1,000-5,000 a day, negotiable for exceptional candidates.
responsibilities: RL post-training: reinforcement learning for reasoning and agent tasks, including GRPO and RLHF
Reward and verifier modelling: reward models, verifiable rewards, self-correction
Agentic post-training: skill, memory and tool-use architecture for agents
Self-evolving harness: training and evaluation systems that keep improving
requirements: Master's or doctoral student in CS, AI, mathematics or physics; strong undergraduates welcome
Research or project experience in reinforcement learning, large models or agents
Genuine research drive and the ability to work through problems independently
At least four days a week on site, for at least three consecutive months
A plus: top-venue papers, substantial open-source work, or familiarity with verl / Megatron / DeepSpeed

zh.title: 研究科学家 · 大模型与智能体后训练
zh.summary: 围绕 DFM 这一研究范式，研究面向科学发现的强化学习、智能体训练与验证机制。
responsibilities: 设计并实现面向科学任务的后训练与强化学习方法
构建可验证的奖励、评测与反馈机制
与科学家合作，把真实问题转化为可训练的任务
requirements: 大模型、强化学习或智能体方向的研究经历
扎实的工程能力，熟悉分布式训练
对科学发现过程有真实兴趣

en.title: Research Scientist · LLM and agent post-training
en.summary: Reinforcement learning, agent training and verification for scientific discovery, within the DFM paradigm.
responsibilities: Design and implement post-training and RL methods for scientific tasks
Build verifiable reward, evaluation and feedback mechanisms
Work with scientists to turn real questions into trainable tasks
requirements: Research experience in LLMs, reinforcement learning or agents
Strong engineering, including distributed training
Genuine interest in how discovery actually happens

zh.title: 研究工程师 · 科学环境与工具
zh.summary: 把真实科学代码库、数据与实验流程封装为可运行、可测量、可复现的研究环境。
responsibilities: 构建与维护科学任务环境与评测
为智能体接入科学工具、数据与实验接口
与领域专家共同固定依赖、定义任务与成功标准
requirements: 熟悉 Python 科学计算生态与容器化
有科学软件、数据流程或实验系统经验者优先
重视可复现性

en.title: Research Engineer · Scientific environments and tools
en.summary: Turn real scientific codebases, data and experimental workflows into runnable, measurable, reproducible research environments.
responsibilities: Build and maintain scientific task environments and evaluations
Connect agents to scientific tools, data and experimental interfaces
Pin dependencies, define tasks and success criteria with domain experts
requirements: Fluent in the Python scientific stack and containers
Experience with scientific software, data pipelines or lab systems preferred
Cares about reproducibility

zh.title: 科学家 · 生命科学与生物医学
zh.summary: 把领域判断、数据与验证条件带进发现链路，与 AI 研究者共同定义值得探索的问题。
responsibilities: 提出并评估具有真实科学价值的问题
设计可验证的实验与分析方案
对模型输出给出专业判断与反馈
requirements: 生命科学或生物医学相关博士学位
有组学、单细胞、疾病机制或实验设计经验
愿意与 AI 系统协作而非只使用工具

en.title: Scientist · Life science and biomedicine
en.summary: Bring domain judgement, data and verification conditions into the discovery loop, and define with AI researchers which questions are worth exploring.
responsibilities: Propose and evaluate questions with real scientific value
Design verifiable experiments and analyses
Judge and give feedback on model outputs
requirements: PhD in life science or biomedicine
Experience in omics, single-cell, disease mechanisms or experiment design
Willing to work with AI systems rather than only use tools
